responsibility: Implements the dominator-walk optimization pass for tree SSA. During a dominator traversal it records edge and statement equivalences, tracks available expressions and const/copy facts with scoped tables, performs constant and copy propagation, folds and simplifies conditionals and switches, removes redundant computations and some redundant stores, updates EH and noreturn edges when simplifications change control effects, and cooperates with jump-threading helpers to expose or realize CFG simplifications based on dominator facts.
same_name_distinction: This source file defines the dominator-walk optimization pass, with the scoped equivalence/availability machinery, propagation and simplification logic, redundant computation/store removal, and CFG/EH updates. Unlike gcc/tree-ssa-dom.h, which only exposes a small shared helper interface such as simple_iv_increment_p and temporary-equivalence recording, this file contains the DOM pass implementation.
